english.title: Employer fail to be insured in accordance with the Employers' Liability (Compulsory Insurance) Act 1969
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, was not insured in accordance with the Employers' Liability (Compulsory Insurance) Act 1969 when required to be so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5 of the Employers' Liability (Compulsory Insurance) Act 1969.

english.notes: Where an offence under section 5 is committed by a corporation with the consent or connivance of, or facilitated by any neglect on the part of, any director, manager, secretary or other officer of the corporation, he, as well as the corporation shall be deemed to be guilty of that offence and shall be liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly
